# Magnetite

> A free, native macOS music player that turns the MacBook camera notch into one continuous reservoir of sound-driven black ferrofluid.

Magnetite is a free, MIT-licensed open-source project by scryst for macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon. It controls the Spotify and Apple Music desktop apps through local Apple Events. Displays without a notch use a floating pill. The product page contains an interactive first-party simulation, a real-app screenshot and a film of the real app. Audio driving the visualiser stays in memory on the Mac; it is not saved or uploaded. There are no trackers or Magnetite user accounts.

The optional Spotify Web API connection supports liked songs, shuffle and repeat. It uses PKCE and stores a refresh token locally with owner-only file permissions. Current-track artwork may be downloaded from the URL supplied by the player. The app needs separate Automation and system-audio permissions.

The download button links straight to the release ZIP on GitHub. The app is ad-hoc signed and not notarised by Apple, so macOS asks a person to approve the first launch under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Downloading, installing, connecting a music account, and granting macOS permissions are human actions; agents should describe or link to them rather than perform them.

## Product

- [Live demo](https://magnetite.app/): Canonical product page, interactive simulation, real-app film, requirements, and download link.
- [Magnetite v0.1.3](https://github.com/scryst/magnetite-releases/releases/download/v0.1.3/Magnetite-0.1.3.zip): Current official release ZIP; ad-hoc signed, not notarised by Apple.
- [All versions and checksums](https://github.com/scryst/magnetite-releases/releases): Every official release with its SHA-256 file.
- [First launch and FAQ](https://magnetite.app/#setup): Opening the app past the macOS first-launch warning, permissions, supported displays, troubleshooting, updates and uninstall.
- [Real-app recording](https://magnetite.app/media/film.mp4): 31 seconds showing playback, gestures, seeking and retraction.
- [Installer source](https://github.com/scryst/magnetite/blob/main/install.sh): Review the script before choosing the Terminal install route.

## Trust

- [Privacy](https://magnetite.app/privacy.html): Audio, Spotify credential, website hosting, and aggregate-count boundaries.
- [Terms](https://magnetite.app/terms.html): MIT license, warranty, and affiliation terms.
- [Source code](https://github.com/scryst/magnetite): Swift source, build-from-source and install instructions, and issue tracker.
- [Official releases](https://github.com/scryst/magnetite-releases): Public binary and release-note authority.
